verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, so data region or residency choice is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose a storage region. The data rooms docs describe secure central storage and access control, and llms.txt says the company is UK-based, but neither offers the customer a residency choice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
